{
  "name": "game-quest",
  "displayName": "GAME MODE · Quest",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "description": "/quest: the task list as a quest log (✓ done, ▶ in progress, · to do, the last one the BOSS), kept across /compact and into the next session in the same project",
  "author": {
    "name": "Reason of Moon",
    "url": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon/bitgame-mods/tree/main/plugins/game-quest",
  "repository": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon/bitgame-mods",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "game-mode",
    "tasks",
    "todo",
    "pane"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "intensity": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Intensity",
      "description": "off draws nothing; casual draws the log; hardcore adds what the quest in progress is doing now",
      "default": "casual",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "casual",
        "hardcore"
      ]
    },
    "palette": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Palette",
      "description": "nes, gameboy and amber are made for dark terminals; theme follows your Claude Code theme (use it on a light background)",
      "default": "nes",
      "options": [
        "nes",
        "gameboy",
        "amber",
        "theme"
      ]
    }
  }
}
